title: Rank One Completion for Higher Order Tensors
summary: We study the rank one completion problem for tensors of arbitrary orders. The notion of rank one determinable tensors is introduced. We explore its properties and propose a recursive algorithm for computing rank one tensor completion. This algorithm only requires solving linear systems and computing singular vectors. In the absence of noise, it produces a unique rank one completion under some assumptions.
